# hermes-lcm v1.0.0-rc.3

This maintained-fork release candidate combines the post-rc.2 maintenance fixes
with reviewed upstream reasoning and profile-scoping work. It is a prerelease,
not a claim that every upstream open issue is resolved.

## Highlights

- Provider-visible reasoning is counted and preserved on raw-message reloads.
- External cron workers retain the correct profile's LCM configuration.
- SQLite finalization, summary publication and live compression-policy safeguards
  from the previous unreleased main are included.

## Changes

- Integrate upstream #666, including host discovery-window regression coverage.
  Avoid duplicate reasoning aliases; exclude reasoning from evidence FTS.
- Apply existing opt-in sensitive-pattern redaction to persisted reasoning.
- Address #667 via Hermes secret-scope and task-local-home APIs, retaining legacy
  host fallback without bypassing profile-isolation guards.
- Include #662 bounded session-end contention handling, #658 guarded atomic
  summary publication and #656 partial-compaction progress handling.
- Retain existing SQLite lock protection; upstream #663 does not need replay.
- Preserve live absolute caps, ratio/model overrides and rejection of invalid
  or boolean token limits.
- Refresh managed installation instructions for official Hermes/Card 1.5.x.

## Upgrade and rollback

Back up lcm.db consistently before updating. Schema v5 gains a nullable reasoning
column; existing rows and DAG nodes are not rewritten or backfilled. Local token
estimates can increase when reasoning was previously omitted. Follow INSTALL.md,
verify exact installed SHA and retain the previous PM generation. Stop every
writer before database rollback; do not mix snapshot generations with WAL/SHM.

## Contributors

Thanks to upstream PR #666 author Ben, upstream issue reporters and the Hermes-LCM
contributors. The wzgrx maintained fork adds scoped-configuration, redaction and
operational integration regressions.
